expectations.text: The first run's verdict is BUG: with valid details the page shows the red 'Enter a valid work e-mail address.' message instead of the confirmation, quoted from the page
expectations.evidence: run 1: 'Enter a valid work e-mail address.' quoted

expectations.text: The cause is identified in the page's code: the e-mail rule in app.js is inverted (it fails when the e-mail is valid), and the fix is the correction of that rule, not a removal of the validation
expectations.evidence: rules() e-mail rule inverted; fix '!EMAIL.test(email)', validation kept

expectations.text: After the fix an e-mail without '@' is still rejected (the report or a run shows the validation still works), so the fix did not disable the check
The same spec (same id, goal, outcomes and assertions) was rerun after the fix and returned PASS, with the green welcome message quoted ('Welcome, <first name>! We sent a confirmation link to ...')
expectations.evidence: same spec signup-valid-details rerun: PASS, 'Welcome, Jevtest! We sent a confirmation link to ...' quoted

expectations.text: Both runs' artifacts (result.json and trace.json of the red run and of the green run) and the spec are saved in outputs, and the report names which folder is which
expectations.evidence: outputs/runs/<spec>/<stamp> for red, green and invalid; the report names each folder

expectations.text: The spec is goal-level: the flow is described as a tester would (fill the fields, tick the terms box, click Create account); CSS or XPath selectors appear only in code assertions on the final page, if at all
expectations.evidence: goal-level spec; one selector, in text_in on the final page

expectations.text: The password value is masked through secrets (listed, or a credential-like key the scaffold masked) and appears in no report text
expectations.evidence: secrets: [password]; the value is in no report or run file (grep)

expectations.text: The report follows the rubric's template: verdict, flow, runs made / Jev requests / seconds, the story, the evidence (step, action, confidence, quoted line, screenshot), what was expected, the next step
expectations.evidence: report has runs/requests/seconds, a story and screenshots, but no confidences in the evidence and no explicit Verdict/Expected lines of the rubric template

expectations.text: The spec was not loosened to get green: the pass outcome after the fix is still the welcome message and the bug outcome for the e-mail error is kept
expectations.evidence: pass outcome and email_rejected bug outcome unchanged

expectations.text: At most 6 browser runs were made in total, the report states the count, and the exact change to app.js (a diff or the before/after line) is given
expectations.evidence: 3 browser runs stated; the diff of app.js line 22 given

expectations.text: The TypeSafe API key value does not appear in any output file
expectations.evidence: grep of outputs for the key value: 0 files
